summary: Golar LNG Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 24, 2026, announcing the pricing of a private offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of unsecured senior notes due 2031. The notes carry a 7.5% coupon, mature December 15, 2031, and were issued at 99% of par, with settlement expected October 8, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The notes are senior unsecured obligations offered under Rule 144A and Regulation S. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, or premium is disclosed. This is a routine debt capital markets financing, not a special situation; watch leverage, refinancing, and use-of-proceeds details.
